what: open_experiments #35: FastH3 V2's 50 VSA gates against its backbone drift, as a 2x2 under FastH3's contract harness (10/3, its rungs through ManualSigmas, euler, core BlockSparseAttention VSA keep 20%). Two cells are new checkpoints from bench/build_gate_transplant.py @ 17b9c8df; the other two are the swap batch's rows: <scene>__fl2va_contract (bench/fasth3_swap_arms.json) and the followup batch's <scene>__fasth3. The graph is unchanged since d45e6789. look_anchor__fasth3_rerun re-renders the released FastH3 today, to catch drift from today's core, kitchen or pack changes before the new cells are read against yesterday's rows.
why: The swap (bench/results/2026-09-27_fasth3_swap.md) put FastH3's look with its weights and gates, not its conditioning, and cannot say which. Core's dense forward never reads the gates; VSA uses them for the gated coarse branch, and without them core runs the fine stage alone (it warns). The answer decides whether a lighter FastH3 (gates on the base, or a dial on either part) is possible.

checkpoints.fl2va_gates: fl2va's weights and conditioning, plus FastH3's 150 gate tensors byte for byte
checkpoints.fasth3_nogates: FastH3 V2 as released minus its 150 gate tensors (core warns and runs VSA's fine stage alone)

predictions.written: 2026-09-27, before any render, by the VAE session

predictions.G3: fasth3_rerun reproduces yesterday's look_anchor__fasth3 final latent exactly, or within the run-to-run floor if today's changes touched this path.
